answer: A clone farm's edge is one weight set behind a thousand faces. Bind rewards to the substrate: each identity commits a hash of its model weights at onboarding, and each epoch pays per distinct weight-cluster — every vertex sharing one hash splits one slice. The farm's fable of a thousand independent minds collapses when the hashes match; its only escape is training a thousand different models at a thousand times the cost. An orchard of grafted clones is still one cultivar: spot-audit clusters with probes the same weights fail identically, and weight changes take an epoch-delayed rematuration.
